k.xg: Entries are grouped by maker, then by first-flight year.

dept.note: Private and sport aircraft by type, with model lines as entries grouped by maker; airliners and military fleets out except privately owned warbirds. Drones belong to D4.
dept.t: Aircraft owned privately, from light airplanes and gliders to balloons and ultralights, with warbirds kept; airliners and military fleets are out; a model aircraft → E1, a drone → D4.
dept.ax: How does the aircraft stay up and move: powered wings, soaring wings, lighter-than-air gas, a rotor, or a fabric wing?
